suggestion: Replace 'any recall drop rejects' with a paired statistical test

suggestion: Record commit SHA, file path and match strategy per grounding status
reason: Folded into the s14 grounding rewrite; assignments are auditable and recomputable.

reason: Reproduced: an 11-row cascade from lines 9 gave level 3 with one event [3]. emitLevelIfRaised now emits one event per level crossed; test pins [2, 3].

suggestion: new page code can pair with a cached older engine (WARNING)
reason: Reproduced statically: the committed engine has no STAR and the new page dereferences J.PIECES.STAR.color at load. The script URL now carries a version query (jacko.js?v=1.1.0) bumped whenever the engine contract changes; package.json version matches.

Verified in browser.

suggestion: a two-level turn announces only the last level (WARNING)
reason: Reproduced: one level cue for a two-level chain. Levels now queue on the animation and play a beat apart after it; verified two level cues.

suggestion: odd-un intro dropped when a turn also raises a level (NITPICK)

suggestion: keydown swallows all keys when a button is focused (WARNING)

suggestion: overdue announcements collapse into one frame (WARNING)
reason: Reproduced: after a 1.5s stall the last two cues fired 1ms apart. tickAnnouncements now plays one per frame and re-bases the rest a beat apart from now; verified gaps of about 650ms after a stall.

reason: The scheduler is a dozen lines with two teardown points (newGame, settleMotion); a controller would add indirection for no gain.

suggestion: scope the button guard to Enter and Space
reason: Same fix as the focused-button finding.

suggestion: a level earned by the drop that also triggers a turn is announced then overwritten (WARNING)
